TECHNOVA 
Leave Policy 2026 

Effective Date: January 1, 2026 
Version: 1.0 
Approved By: Board of Directors

Introduction and Scope 
1.0 Introduction 
At Technova, we believe that clear guidelines regarding time off help maintain both professional 
clarity and personal well-being. 
1.1 Purpose and Scope 
This document defines the official leave policies and procedural frameworks for all employees at 
Technova. The clear goal of this policy is to deliver a fair, transparent, and consistent system for 
managing employee time off. It ensures that every team member understands their personal time 
entitlements and the exact steps required to submit a request. This framework supports personal 
well-being while protecting day-to-day business operations and client deadlines. This policy 
completely supersedes any previous leave agreements, whether written or spoken. 
1.2 Our Philosophy on Work-Life Balance 
We recognize that our people are Technova’s most valuable asset. We are fully committed to 
fostering an open, supportive work environment that highlights a healthy work-life balance. 
Adequate rest and regular time away from work are essential for long-term health, daily morale, 
creative engagement, and engineering productivity. Our leave guidelines provide the flexibility 
needed to handle family needs, explore personal interests, and return to work recharged. 
1.3 Applicability 
This policy applies directly to all full-time and part-time permanent employees of Technova. 
Contractual staff, temporary workers, and interns may operate under different leave terms outlined 
specifically in their individual employment agreements. Provisions may adjust dynamically based on 
local labor laws in the jurisdictions where we operate. In any scenario where a conflict arises, local 
labor law will take priority. 
1.4 Key Definitions 
• 
Employee: Any individual employed by Technova on a permanent full-time or part-time 
basis. 
• 
Manager: A team member holding direct supervisory responsibility for other employees. 
• 
HR Department: The internal Human Resources department at Technova. 
• 
HRIS: The Human Resources Information System platform used to log requests and manage 
leave balances. 
• 
Leave Year: The official twelve-month calculation cycle, running from January 1st to 
December 31st. 
• 
Accrual: The ongoing process of earning time-off credits over a set period of service. 
• 
Medical Practitioner: A licensed and registered doctor or healthcare professional.

General Leave Guidelines 
2.0 General Leave Provisions 
These standard provisions govern how leave is tracked, submitted, and managed throughout the 
calendar year. 
2.1 The Leave Year 
The official leave year at Technova matches the calendar year, beginning January 1, 2026, and 
concluding December 31, 2026. All calculations are based on this window. For any employee joining 
Technova mid-year, their time-off entitlements will be prorated based on their remaining months of 
active service. 
2.2 Procedure for Requesting Leave 
All time-off requests, excluding sudden emergencies like illness, must be submitted in advance 
through the company's HRIS portal. When logging a request, employees must clearly input the 
specific leave type, start date, end date, and any helpful notes for the reviewer. Verbal notices or 
email updates are excellent for initial team communication but do not count as official submissions. 
An official HRIS request must be entered as soon as it is practical to do so. 
2.3 Approval Workflow 
Requests entered into the HRIS route directly to the employee's line manager for evaluation. 
Managers must review these requests promptly, balancing individual requests against team 
workload, upcoming product deadlines, and operational coverage. If a direct manager is out of the 
office, a designated alternate approver will handle incoming requests. Employees receive automated 
alerts when a request is approved or denied. If a request is turned down, the manager must provide 
a clear reason. 
2.4 Leave Balance and Accrual 
Team members can verify their live balances, accrual history, and upcoming time projections anytime 
via the self-service dashboard in the HRIS. Leave credits accrue steadily on a monthly or bi-weekly 
basis depending on your specific payroll cycle. 
Balances, Probation, and Departures 
2.5 Leave Carry-Forward 
Technova actively encourages every employee to use their complete vacation allocation during the 
2026 calendar year. If business needs or personal schedules get in the way, the following rules apply: 
• 
Paid Time Off (PTO): A maximum of 5 unused PTO days can carry forward into the 2027 leave 
year. 
• 
Sick Leave: Unused sick leave can carry forward up to a maximum safety cap of 45 days to 
support employees during unforeseen, long-term medical situations. 
• 
Deadlines: Any carried-forward leave must be used within the first quarter of the new year 
(by March 31, 2027) or it will officially lapse. 
2.6 Leave Encashment

Because we value rest and recovery, Technova does not permit cash payouts for leave days during 
your active employment. Upon formal separation from the company, any accrued and unused PTO 
will be paid out in your final settlement package according to local laws. 
2.7 Leave During Probation Period 
Employees currently serving their introductory probation period will accrue leave credits according 
to standard policy. However, taking elective PTO during the first 90 days is generally discouraged and 
remains subject to strict manager discretion. Sick leave and statutory options remain fully available if 
needed. 
2.8 Leave During Notice Period 
Once an employee enters their resignation notice period, elective leave is generally not permitted. 
Exceptions are made only for verified medical emergencies. Pre-planned leave may be reviewed by 
management and HR on a case-by-case basis. Technova reserves the right to extend the notice 
period by the exact number of leave days taken. 
2.9 Unauthorized Absence 
An unexcused absence lasting three or more consecutive business days without any notification to a 
manager or HR is considered an unauthorized absence. This is handled as job abandonment and can 
result in disciplinary action up to immediate termination. 
2.10 Contact During Leave 
When on leave, you should disconnect from work entirely. Set up an out-of-office auto-reply on your 
email and messaging channels detailing alternative team contacts. Managers will only reach out to 
an employee on leave during a genuine, critical business emergency that no one else can resolve. 
Paid Time Off (PTO) 
3.0 Paid Time Off (PTO) / Annual Leave 
PTO gives our team regular, paid windows to step away from daily tasks to rest, travel, handle 
personal logistics, or recharge. 
3.1 Purpose 
Paid Time Off is vital for maintaining high performance and personal health. We want you to use this 
time for deliberate rest. 
3.2 Eligibility and Entitlement 
All permanent Technova employees are eligible for paid annual leave. Your total yearly entitlement 
scales based on your continuous tenure with the company: 
• 
0 to 2 Years of Service: 18 days of annual PTO. 
• 
2 to 5 Years of Service: 22 days of annual PTO. 
• 
5+ Years of Service: 25 days of annual PTO. 
• 
Part-Time Staff: Entitlements are prorated cleanly based on contracted working hours. 
3.3 Accrual Schedule

PTO builds up progressively each month. For instance, a team member with an 18-day annual 
allowance will see exactly 1.5 days of PTO added to their balance at the completion of each full 
month of service. 
3.4 Planning and Scheduling PTO 
• 
Short Leave: For time off lasting fewer than 5 consecutive business days, log your request at 
least two weeks in advance. 
• 
Long Leave: For absences of 5 or more business days, log your request at least four weeks in 
advance. 
• 
Blackout Windows: During peak product launches or critical client deployment periods, 
Technova may temporarily restrict elective PTO requests to ensure coverage. 
• 
Increments: PTO must be taken in minimum blocks of a half-day (4 hours). 
• 
Negative Balances: Employees cannot run a negative leave balance; your requested time off 
must not exceed your current accrued balance. 
3.5 PTO Case Study: Planning a Vacation 
• 
Scenario: Sarah has crossed 3 years of service at Technova (giving her 22 annual days) and 
wants to take a 10-day summer vacation. 
• 
Action: Six weeks before her trip, Sarah checks her HRIS portal and confirms she has 12 
accrued days available. She enters a formal 10-day request. Her manager reviews the project 
timeline, confirms team coverage is sufficient, and approves it. Sarah configures her out-of-
office notice and logs off cleanly. 
: Sick Leave Guidelines 
4.0 Sick Leave 
Sick leave ensures that employees can prioritize their health or care for immediate family members 
during unexpected illness or medical situations without financial worry. 
4.1 Purpose 
This leave is strictly allocated for recovery from unexpected personal illness, injury, or to attend 
essential medical appointments. 
4.2 Entitlement 
All full-time employees receive 12 days of paid sick leave at the start of each calendar year. Sick leave 
does not accrue monthly; the full 12-day balance is available immediately on January 1, 2026 (or 
prorated appropriately if you join Technova mid-year). 
4.3 Notification Procedure 
If you are too unwell to perform your duties, inform your direct manager via call, text, or email as 
early as possible—ideally before your scheduled start time. A formal sick leave request must be 
entered into the HRIS portal on the day you call out or immediately upon your physical return to 
work. 
4.4 Medical Certification Requirements

• 
Consecutive Days: For any medical call-out lasting three or more consecutive business days, 
you must upload a doctor's note from a registered medical practitioner into the HRIS. 
• 
Certificate Details: The note must explicitly state the dates you were unfit for duty. To 
protect your personal privacy, it should not reveal private diagnostic details. 
• 
Short Absences: Technova reserves the right to request a formal medical note for shorter 
absences if an employee shows a recurring pattern of frequent short-term call-outs. 
4.5 Long-Term Sickness and Returning to Work 
If a severe medical issue requires an extended absence, contact HR to discuss structured options, 
such as corporate disability benefits or an extended unpaid leave of absence. For medical absences 
that exceed 10 consecutive business days, you must provide a formal fitness-to-work certificate 
before resuming active duties to ensure you can return safely. 
4.6 Sick Leave Case Study: Handling an Illness 
• 
Scenario: John wakes up on a Tuesday morning with a severe fever and cannot work. 
• 
Action: At 8:00 AM, John sends a message to his manager detailing his illness. His recovery 
takes four days. On Monday, his first day back, he opens the HRIS, logs a 4-day sick leave 
request, and uploads a digital scan of his doctor's note. 
 Public Holidays and Parental Leaves 
5.0 Public Holidays 
Technova provides paid time off for designated public holidays every year. 
5.1 Official Holiday Schedule 
The company observes 10 paid public holidays each year. The official operational calendar and 
observed dates are published by HR at the start of January. Permanent employees receive full pay for 
these days. 
5.2 Floating Holidays 
When public holidays fall on weekends, Technova will designate an alternate weekday off or provide 
floating holiday credits, allowing teams to maintain a balanced rest schedule. 
6.0 Maternity Leave 
We provide robust support frameworks for expecting mothers to ensure peace of mind during 
childbirth and early infant care. 
6.1 Purpose and Eligibility 
All permanent full-time female employees are eligible for fully paid Maternity Leave. This policy 
ensures adequate recovery time and bonding space without impacting career continuity. 
6.2 Duration and Application 
Maternity leave duration complies fully with or exceeds regional statutory minimums. Employees 
should submit an application in the HRIS at least four weeks before their expected leave date, 
attaching basic medical documentation from their doctor. All standard insurance and employment

benefits continue uninterrupted throughout the leave window. A formal return-to-work plan can be 
coordinated with HR to ensure a smooth ramp-up. 
7.0 Paternity Leave 
Technova recognizes the vital role of partners during the arrival of a new child. 
7.1 Eligibility and Pay 
All permanent employees welcoming a new child via birth or legal adoption are eligible for paid 
Paternity Leave. This leave provides full salary coverage for a designated period, allowing parents to 
focus entirely on family bonding. Requests should be submitted through the HRIS portal ahead of 
time, ensuring clear coordination with your direct team. 
 Bereavement and Civic Duties 
8.0 Bereavement Leave 
We provide compassionate, paid time off to support employees navigating the loss of a loved one. 
8.1 Purpose and Entitlement 
Permanent employees are eligible for paid Bereavement Leave following the passing of an 
immediate or extended family member. This time is provided so employees can attend services, 
handle personal logistics, and grieve with family. 
8.2 Family Definitions and Procedures 
Immediate family includes spouses, children, parents, and siblings. Extended family definitions cover 
grandparents, parents-in-law, and legal guardians. Employees must notify their manager as soon as 
possible and log the request in the HRIS upon their return. Technova prioritizes empathy over 
paperwork, though basic documentation may be requested if needed for administrative records. 
9.0 Jury Duty and Civic Responsibility Leave 
Technova fully supports our team members in fulfilling their civic duties and legal obligations. 
9.1 Purpose and Pay 
We provide fully paid Civic Leave when an employee is officially summoned for jury duty, called as a 
witness, or required by law to participate in public service. Technova will maintain your regular salary 
for the duration of your verified civic service. 
9.2 Documentation 
Employees must upload a copy of the official court summons or civic notice into the HRIS as soon as 
they receive it. If your civic service finishes early on any given day, you are expected to check in with 
your manager or resume remote work if practical. 
Unpaid Leave and Compassionate Care 
10.0 Unpaid Leave of Absence (LOA) 
An Unpaid Leave of Absence allows employees to take extended time away from work for 
exceptional personal reasons when their accrued paid leave balances are exhausted. 
10.1 Eligibility and Review

Permanent employees who have completed their introductory probation period can apply for an 
unpaid LOA. Every application is evaluated individually based on the underlying reason, current team 
workloads, and overall business impacts. 
10.2 Application Process 
Requests must be submitted in writing to your manager and HR at least four weeks in advance, 
detailing the desired duration and reason for the request. Taking an unapproved unpaid absence will 
be managed as an unauthorized departure from your role. 
10.3 Impact on Benefits 
During an extended unpaid LOA, regular salary payments stop. Depending on the length of the 
absence, certain company-sponsored benefits or insurance accruals may be paused or adjusted in 
accordance with local labor laws. Your exact return date and role continuity parameters will be 
confirmed in writing by HR before your leave begins. 
11.0 Compassionate Leave 
Compassionate leave provides dedicated flexibility for employees who need to step away to care for 
a loveSd one navigating a major medical crisis. 
11.1 Purpose and Distinction 
While Bereavement Leave applies specifically to the passing of a family member, Compassionate 
Leave is designed for critical care situations. It applies when an immediate family member suffers a 
sudden, life-threatening illness or severe physical injury, requiring the employee's direct presence 
and care. Log these requests through the HRIS, coordinating closely with HR for any extended care 
planning. 
Special Categories and Responsibilities 
12.0 Special Leave Categories 
Technova provides additional structured leave categories to support unique personal or legal 
obligations. 
12.1 Adoption Leave 
To support teams expanding their families, our Adoption Leave policy offers matching time-off 
parameters to our standard parental leave frameworks, ensuring equitable support for all parents. 
12.2 Voting Leave 
Technova ensures all eligible employees have sufficient time to cast their ballots in local, state, or 
national elections. If your regular working hours overlap significantly with polling hours, coordinate 
with your manager to schedule paid time off to vote. 
12.3 Military Service Leave 
Employees called up for active or reserve military duty will receive a structured leave of absence 
matching all local statutory requirements, protecting their role continuity and seniority. 
13.0 Roles and Responsibilities 
Clear collaboration ensures our leave policies work smoothly across our engineering teams.

13.1 Employee Responsibilities 
• 
Log all leave requests accurately and ahead of time within the HRIS portal. 
• 
Communicate upcoming absences clearly to your team to protect project delivery. 
• 
Set up clear out-of-office notices and hand over critical tasks before logging off. 
13.2 Manager Responsibilities 
• 
Review incoming leave requests fairly and promptly, keeping team metrics in mind. 
• 
Support your team's work-life balance while ensuring operational commitments are met. 
• 
Document clear, objective reasons in the HRIS if a time-off request must be denied. 
13.3 HR Department Responsibilities 
• 
Maintain and update leave frameworks to stay aligned with shifting labor laws. 
• 
Provide clear guidance to managers and teams on complex leave scenarios. 
• 
Securely manage all sensitive medical notes and certification records with strict 
confidentiality. 
FAQs and Administration 
14.0 Policy Administration 
This policy is managed neutrally to ensure consistent, fair application across all business units. 
14.1 Exceptions and Confidentiality 
Any exception to the guidelines in this document requires formal written approval from the Head of 
HR and the Executive Leadership Team. All health records, medical notes, and personal justifications 
shared for leave approvals are treated with high confidentiality and stored securely apart from 
standard corporate directories. 
15.0 Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) 
Q1: How do I submit a time-off request? A: All leave must be logged through the company's HRIS 
portal. Head to the "Time Off" dashboard, choose your leave category, input your desired dates, and 
submit it to your manager for digital approval. 
Q2: Can my direct manager turn down a PTO request? A: Yes. While Technova encourages taking 
time off, approvals remain subject to active business needs. A manager may decline a request if it 
conflicts directly with critical delivery deadlines or if multiple team members have requested the 
same dates. Your manager must provide a clear reason and work with you to find a better time. 
Q3: What happens if I get sick during a planned PTO vacation? A: If you fall ill for three or more 
consecutive days during your PTO and can provide a valid medical certificate, you can request to 
reclassify those specific days as Sick Leave. Notify your manager immediately and update your entry 
in the HRIS upon your return to credit those PTO days back to your balance. 
Q4: Are public holidays paid days off? A: Yes, all officially designated public holidays are fully paid 
days off for permanent Technova staff.
